name: EPIC 220288980
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 8.8 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,540 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.91 solar masses and 8.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,047 K at its surface.
